name: net.blackdialsolutions/illinois-business-signals
title: Illinois Business Signals
description: Checks if an Illinois business is registered and active, and lists new filings by county.

tools.name: verify_business
tools.description:
Is this business registered in Illinois, and is it still active? Illinois only.
Inputs: name (2-200 chars), state (IL or Illinois), optional city (max 100), optional zip (5 digits or ZIP+4).
Price: $0.02 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free).
Verdicts:
- active: Registered and in good standing, or still active with a status flag listed in flags.
- inactive: The state record shows the entity dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, merged or otherwise no longer active.
- possible_match: A record with a similar, not identical, name exists. Its status is in match.record_verdict. Confirm with the business's ZIP code, or by comparing the returned name, before relying on it. A similar-name match to a corporation always stays possible_match, because the state publishes no address for corporations.
- not_found: No matching record in the covered Illinois data. not_found does not mean the business is fake.
- unknown: A record exists but the data cannot say whether it still operates (Will County DBA filings, or an unrecognised status).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
possible_match is confirmed only by a matching ZIP, never by city alone. not_found does not mean the business is fake: insurers, banks and other entities chartered outside the Secretary of State, and sole proprietors and general partnerships outside Will County, are not covered. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","state":"IL","zip":"60435"}
Example response: {"verdict":"active","confidence":1,"flags":["annual_report_current"],"match":{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","record_verdict":"active","county":"Will","county_source":"office","source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"2026-11-14T06:00:00.000Z"},"alternatives":[]}

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description:
The same status check as verify_business for 1 to 100 Illinois businesses in one call. Use it for lead lists. A bad item returns an error object in its own slot and is not counted; a batch with no valid item is refused and costs nothing.
Inputs: businesses, an array of {name, state, optional city, optional zip}, same limits as verify_business.
Price: $1.00 flat per call with x402. Under 50 names, single verify_business calls are cheaper. A monthly API key also works: one unit per valid business. Call coverage first (free).

- active: Registered and in good standing, or still active with a status flag listed in flags.
- inactive: The state record shows the entity dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, merged or otherwise no longer active.
- possible_match: A record with a similar, not identical, name exists. Its status is in match.record_verdict. Confirm with the business's ZIP code, or by comparing the returned name, before relying on it. A similar-name match to a corporation always stays possible_match, because the state publishes no address for corporations.
- not_found: No matching record in the covered Illinois data. not_found does not mean the business is fake.
- unknown: A record exists but the data cannot say whether it still operates (Will County DBA filings, or an unrecognised status).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
possible_match is confirmed only by a matching ZIP, never by city alone. not_found does not mean the business is fake: insurers, banks and other entities chartered outside the Secretary of State, and sole proprietors and general partnerships outside Will County, are not covered. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"businesses":[{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","state":"IL","zip":"60435"},{"name":"Sample Hardware Co","state":"IL"}]}
Example response: {"results":[{"verdict":"active","match":{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","county_source":"office","source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"..."}},{"verdict":"not_found","match":null}]}

businesses.description: 1 to 100 objects of {name, state, city?, zip?}, the same fields as verify_business.

tools.name: new_filings
tools.description:
Which businesses newly registered in one Illinois county? Newest first, from the Secretary of State files (plus Will County assumed-name filings).
Inputs: county (required, one county per call, e.g. Will or DuPage), optional industry (text matched against industry_guess), optional since (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back, default 30), optional limit (1 to 50, default 20), optional include_foreign (true or false, default true).
Price: $0.05 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
Caveats: industry_guess is a guess from the business name, with industry_guess_basis saying how; it is often null. Foreign companies (formed in another state, registered in Illinois) are included by default and labelled foreign: true; send include_foreign false to leave them out. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"county":"Will","since":"2026-11-01","limit":5}
Example response: {"count":1,"total_matching":1,"records":[{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","entity_type":"LLC","foreign":false,"filing_date":"2026-11-10","county":"Will","county_source":"office","industry_guess":null,"source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"..."}],"data_as_of":{...},"notes":[]}

county.description: Illinois county name, for example Will or DuPage. One county per call.

industry.description: Optional text matched against industry_guess, for example construction.

since.description: Optional start date YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back. Default 30 days.

include_foreign.description: Optional. false leaves out out-of-state companies registered in Illinois. Default true.
